The materialized Atlas assigns src/app/fiokom/b2b/page.tsx to DOMAIN-STOREFRONT / shared-storefront.

alternatives.summary: Remove the unused import and void anchor from the B2B page.

challenge.scenario: Removing the dead B2B Builder anchor leaves the public B2B page with no materialized Atlas domain on main.
challenge.finding: Knowledge correctly blocks SQ_ATLAS_DOMAIN_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED because the legacy materializer does not consume the generic Storefront fallback.
challenge.resolution: Bind src/app/fiokom/** explicitly to existing DOMAIN-STOREFRONT authority and prove the materialized Atlas node, without creating a new domain or execution exception.

proofPlan: Run Knowledge, Plan Before Code, Edit-Time Guard and Incremental Replay on the isolated exact-head prerequisite.
Prove the materialized Atlas node for src/app/fiokom/b2b/page.tsx resolves to DOMAIN-STOREFRONT / shared-storefront.

requirements.requirement: The B2B page removes the side-effect-free Builder manifest runtime anchor, materializes under canonical Storefront presentation authority, and preserves B2B behavior plus the independent Builder manifest.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Removing the dead anchor must not change B2B account runtime behavior.
The canonical B2B Builder manifest must remain independently defined and covered.

notes: Isolated from #681 because Release Risk Budget correctly rejected a combined quality-infrastructure + release-infrastructure + customer-account release transaction at 6/5 points. This prerequisite keeps the unrelated two-line runtime cleanup in its own release transaction instead of weakening the budget. The prerequisite now binds src/app/fiokom/** explicitly to the already-existing DOMAIN-STOREFRONT presentation authority and adds materialized-Atlas regression proof; no new authority or exception is introduced.
